summary: A multi-line text field. Every size and state is Input's; it wraps and it resizes vertically.
useWhen: the answer is prose — a description, a note, a message — and may run past one line
the user should be able to see several lines of what they wrote at once

useInstead.when: the value is a single short string — a name, an email, a search term
useInstead.why: a one-line answer in a three-line box tells the user to write more than you want

useInstead.when: the answer is one of a known set
useInstead.why: free text you intend to parse into categories is a Select you have not built yet

useInstead.when: the field needs formatting controls or renders markup
useInstead.why: a rich-text editor is not in this library, and a textarea styled to look like one will not behave like one

lg.use: roomy layouts, and the primary field on a page

guarantees: the label, helper text and error message are wired to the control by React Aria's useTextField, so the accessible name and description are correct without the caller doing anything
`errorMessage` replaces the helper text only when `isInvalid` is set, and is announced as the field's description
the focus ring shows for keyboard focus only, and hover does not latch on touch
resize is disabled when the field is, matching what browsers do with a disabled textarea
requires: `label`, or an `aria-label` when the field is labelled by something on the page — an unlabelled textarea is announced only as "edit text"

a visible error cue that is not the border. THE INVALID BORDER IS 1px AS OF 0.49.0 and differs from a default field by hue alone, so pass `errorMessage` — WCAG 1.4.1 is not satisfied by the border on its own

antiPatterns.avoid: setting a fixed `height` in CSS to size the box
antiPatterns.instead: use `rows`. The Figma height is derived from three lines of a bound line-height, so a fixed height pins the box while the text inside it keeps scaling with the type ramp
the browser paints one for `resize: vertical` and it cannot be styled or suppressed independently, so a custom grip sits beside it and the field gets two

antiPatterns.avoid: relying on `isInvalid` alone to communicate an error
antiPatterns.instead: pass `errorMessage` too. The border is 1px and the same width as every other state, so colour is the only difference without it
